Review complete. Verdict: **approve** (tier2 — still requires human sign-off before merge, not autonomous).

Key finding worth flagging: the diff pasted into my review prompt was itself truncated mid-file — the same 60000-byte supervisor-pipeline issue this PR's own history already documents. I pulled the full diff directly from the repo with `git diff origin/main...HEAD`, reviewed all 27 files, ran `tsc --noEmit` (clean) and the 5 phase_8 test files together (41/41 pass, no cross-file mock leak). The implementation is solid: proper permission gating, parameterized Drizzle queries, sensible RLS policy design, and an import path that never trusts client-supplied semver/lifecycle claims. `review-verdict.json` is written with full details and two non-blocking issues noted (migrations not yet applied live; a minor race-condition edge case on concurrent same-locale translation calls).
